51039647.protein: Induced myeloid leukemia cell differentiation protein Mcl-1
51039647.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to cMcl-1 (residues 171 to 327) (unknown origin) by ITC assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) was performed using ITC200 (Microcal). Experiments were performed in 20 mM Tris pH 8.0, 150 mM NaCl, 1% DMSO at 25 °C. For evaluating Kd value of 6d compared with that of 3, titrations consisted of 12 × 3 μL injections of compound at 300 μM into Mcl-1 (30 μM). For evaluating Kd values of analogues toward wild-type Mcl-1 compared with that toward Mcl-1 R263A, titrations consisted of 16 × 2.5 μL injections of compound at 500 μM into Mcl-1 (50 μM). All sample data obtained after control data corrections were analyzed to fit to a one-site model. For control ITC experiments, the sample cells were filled with assay buffer and the compound solution was added. This process was identical to that for protein samples.
original_paragraph.Figure 5 caption: Figure 5. (a) Raw data for titration of 3 and (b) 6d into Mcl-1. Titrations consisted of 12 × 3 μL injections of compound at 300 μM into Mcl-1 (30 μM). Each peak corresponds to one injection. Kd value was calculated from integration of the raw data.
original_paragraph.Table 3 caption: Table 3 Binding affinity of compounds with Mcl-1 and R263A mutant by ITC Assay (Kd, μM)
original_paragraph.Table 3 data: The table lists Kd values for compounds 3, 6b, 6d, and 8c against wild-type Mcl-1 and Mcl-1 R263A mutant. For example, compound 6d has a Kd of 0.105 μM for wild-type Mcl-1 and 2.34 μM for the R263A mutant.
original_paragraph.Figure 5 data: The inset tables in Figure 5 show the calculated thermodynamic parameters. For Mcl-1 + 3: Kd = 964.2 ± 2.83 μM, ΔG = -8.27 kcal/mol, ΔH = -6.42 ± 0.65 kcal/mol, -TΔS = -1.85 kcal/mol. For Mcl-1 + 6d: Kd = 105.3 ± 1.47 μM, ΔG = -9.59 kcal/mol, ΔH = -5.78 ± 1.03 kcal/mol, -TΔS = -3.81 kcal/mol.
